coordinate_system: First usable end-effector frame within each sweep. Millimetres. Anatomical LPS mapping unverified; sweep frames differ.
prediction_status: Final B-mode nnU-Net fitted on 685 human masks from six sweeps, usable frames only. Held-out groups reach micro Dice 0.79-0.85 on the small phantom and 0.44-0.55 on the big phantom. 192447, 192754 and 194903 have no human masks. All predictions remain unreviewed suggestions.
browser_preview: Computes trilinear weighted accumulation and Gaussian-normalized compounding from 16/32/64 sampled frames. Distinct from full-sweep 0.3 mm reference exports.

model_training.score_scope: Scores come from held-out models that never saw the sweep's group; the final model was then fitted on all 685 masks and has no score of its own.
